name: sales-crm-root
description: Multi-tenant Lead Generation CRM - Modular Monolith

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
